solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Routes finances dubiously, rendering liquid property

indicators.note: money moved dubiously is shuffled about, so the letters of the two words are rearranged

explanation.surface: A shady operator is moving money through odd channels, which turns assets liquid.
explanation.walkthrough: 'liquid property' reads like financial jargon for cash-like assets, but it is physics: a property of liquids.
explanation.definitionFit: The cohesive skin effect on a liquid's surface is a physical characteristic that liquids exhibit.

clue.text: Timeless headgear for old pope?

indicators.note: time is abbreviated T, so being without time means that letter is dropped

parts.note: a turban is a wrapped head covering

explanation.surface: A jokey question about what hat an ancient pontiff might have worn.
explanation.definitionFit: Several popes of history took the name Urban, so it serves as a name for an old pontiff.

clue.text: Call for temporary halt in painting

indicators.note: a call is something spoken, so the word meant is the one that sounds like the stop

parts.note: a freeze is a temporary halt, as on prices or pay

explanation.surface: Someone demands a pause in the decorating work.
explanation.definitionFit: A decorative band of painted or carved design along the top of a wall is a kind of painting.

clue.text: Ties up donkey? Camels may soon be exhausted if you do!

definitions.text: Camels may soon be exhausted if you do!

parts.note: to tie up is to chain, giving the verb form with S
moke is British slang for a donkey

explanation.surface: Tethering a donkey, then a quip about camels being worn out.
explanation.walkthrough: Camel is a brand of cigarette; a pack is soon used up by someone lighting one after another. MOKE is old British slang for a donkey.
explanation.definitionFit: Lighting cigarette after cigarette uses up a packet of Camels, the cigarette brand, very quickly.

clue.text: Sentimental social media message one character short

indicators.note: a message lacking one letter has its final character removed

parts.note: a tweet is a post on Twitter

explanation.surface: A soppy online post that falls just short of the character limit.
explanation.definitionFit: Twee describes something excessively quaint, cute or mawkish, a synonym for sentimental.

clue.text: Number to play on guitar — Bad Medicine?

parts.note: to strum is to play a guitar by sweeping the strings

explanation.surface: A song to strum, and 'Bad Medicine' is the title of a Bon Jovi hit.
explanation.definitionFit: A quack remedy of dubious effect is a nostrum, so bad medicine fits.

clue.text: Naughty child getting dental cast fixed

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous child

indicators.note: to cast can mean to throw about, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A misbehaving child gets a dental mould taken.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cast' looks like a dental mould but is the anagram signal: DENTAL rearranged gives LANTED.
explanation.definitionFit: Something embedded or set firmly in place, such as a tooth implant, is fixed.

clue.text: Source of luminance interrupting darkness between Norway, the tip of Russia and Sweden?

definitions.text: Source of luminance interrupting darkness between Norway, the tip of Russia and Sweden?

indicators.note: the lit-up night sits between the run of country letters and the final letter for Sweden

parts.note: Nor. is an abbreviation for Norway

indicators.note: the tip of a word is its first letter

parts.note: S is the international vehicle code for Sweden

indicators.note: breaking into the dark word, so one letter goes inside it

parts.note: night is darkness

indicators.note: the source of a word is where it starts, its first letter

explanation.surface: The aurora breaking up the Arctic night over Scandinavia and Russia.
explanation.walkthrough: Read as a whole, the clue also describes the aurora itself, seen in far-northern skies over those countries.
explanation.definitionFit: The aurora borealis glows in high-latitude skies such as those over Norway, Sweden and northern Russia.

clue.text: Seasoned old pros reject adopting current retro picture-sharing application

indicators.note: to adopt is to take in, so one piece is placed inside the other
seasoned suggests mixed with spices, so these letters are stirred into a new order

parts.note: I is the symbol for electric current

explanation.surface: Veteran professionals turn down a nostalgic photo-sharing app.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Seasoned' sounds like 'experienced' describing the pros, but it is the anagram signal; 'adopting' then puts I inside the rearranged letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Before phones and apps, families shared holiday photos by projecting slides onto a screen, an old-fashioned way of showing pictures.

clue.text: Oil rig built with care

indicators.note: to rig is to fix or manipulate, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An oil rig constructed with great attention.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Oil rig' reads as one thing, but 'Oil' is the definition and 'rig' signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: To oil a machine is to grease it so parts move smoothly, the same as applying a lubricant.

clue.text: Fantastic meal only 1p!

indicators.note: the evening meal's name has two Ps, and keeping only one means dropping a P

parts.note: supper is an evening meal

explanation.surface: An excited advert: a fantastic meal for a single penny.
explanation.walkthrough: 1p looks like a price of one penny but means 'only one letter P'.
explanation.definitionFit: Super is an informal exclamation of approval, a synonym for fantastic or marvellous.

clue.text: Resident retreat with one getting religion

parts.note: a den is a private retreat
I is the Roman numeral one
Zen is a school of Buddhism

explanation.surface: Someone who lives in a hideaway and takes up a faith.
explanation.definitionFit: A denizen is an inhabitant of a place, someone who lives there.

clue.text: Advocate system for counting votes of everyone?

parts.note: PR stands for proportional representation, an electoral system
each refers to every one of a group individually

explanation.surface: A campaigner backs a voting system that represents everyone.
explanation.definitionFit: To advocate a cause is to urge or promote it publicly, which is what preaching does.

clue.text: Cautious, self-righteous type, oddly not likable

parts.note: a prude is someone priggishly disapproving

indicators.note: taking the odd-numbered letters of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A description of a wary, sanctimonious person nobody warms to.
explanation.walkthrough: 'oddly' takes letters 1, 3, 5, 7, 9 of NOTLIKABLE, giving NTIAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Prudential means exercising prudence, so careful or wary in the way a cautious person is.

clue.text: Fuel energy found in animal dung?

indicators.note: one letter is located inside the other piece

parts.note: a pat is a lump of dung, as in cowpat
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Asks whether dried animal droppings can be burned for energy.
explanation.definitionFit: Dried peat cut from bogs is burned for heating, so it is a fuel.

clue.text: Finding inspiration difficult, perhaps, as with recurrent idea that's lacking direction

indicators.note: a compass direction such as east, E, is removed

parts.note: thematic means having a running theme, a recurrent idea

explanation.surface: An artist struggles for inspiration, trapped by one recurring idea.
explanation.walkthrough: 'inspiration' looks creative but means breathing in, which asthma makes hard.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with asthma struggles to breathe in, a literal reading of inspiration being difficult.

clue.text: The setter's punctilious nature pointlessly requiring permission

parts.note: the setter is 'I', so 'the setter is' becomes I'm
prim means stiffly proper and precise

indicators.note: compass points N and E are removed

explanation.surface: The setter claims a fussy disposition needs official approval.
explanation.definitionFit: An imprimatur is an official licence to print, and by extension any authoritative sanction or approval.

clue.text: Frightfully honest children in trouble

indicators.note: frightfully suggests things thrown into disorder, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: kids are children

explanation.surface: Children who are terribly truthful get themselves into a mess.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom for a person or business in decline and heading for failure; to be in trouble.

clue.text: Attained maturity after putting back up with self-promotion

indicators.note: in a down entry, putting the back letter up means the last letter moves to the top

parts.note: got ripe means reached maturity, as fruit does

explanation.surface: Someone reaches adulthood, then turns to blowing their own trumpet.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer 'up' is the top, so the final E of GOTRIPE moves to the front.
explanation.definitionFit: An ego trip is an activity pursued to boost one's self-image, a form of self-promotion.

clue.text: Revered figure's independent living allowance cut off

indicators.note: the end of the word is chopped off

parts.note: the dole is British unemployment benefit

explanation.surface: A celebrity's state support for independent living is stopped.
explanation.walkthrough: The dole is the informal British name for unemployment benefit. The 's stands for 'is', a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An idol is a person or image worshipped or greatly admired, a revered figure.

clue.text: It's rumoured fool kissed face

indicators.note: something rumoured is passed on by word of mouth, so these words are spoken

parts.note: an ass is a fool and pecked means kissed lightly

explanation.surface: Gossip says some idiot kissed someone's face.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspect is a side or facet of something, so a face of a problem or building.

clue.text: Old North African upland area

parts.note: ex means former
a Moor is a North African of Berber or Arab descent

explanation.surface: Describes a highland region in North Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: Exmoor is moorland in south-west England, in Somerset and Devon.
explanation.definitionFit: Exmoor is a national park of high moorland in south-west England.

clue.text: Husk of oats and bits of edible bran carried by horse?

definitions.text: Husk of oats and bits of edible bran carried by horse?

indicators.note: the letters are held inside the horse word

parts.note: a nag is an old horse

indicators.note: the husk is the outer shell, so the outside letters
the first bits, the initial letters, of each word

explanation.surface: A horse carrying its feed of oats and bran.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue also describes the bag of feed a horse wears.
explanation.definitionFit: A feed bag hung over a horse's head holds oats and bran for it to eat.

clue.text: Well done, coming ahead of Charlie!

definitions.meaning: a shout of applause for a fine performance
in the NATO phonetic alphabet B's code word comes right before C's, Charlie

explanation.surface: Congratulating someone for finishing in front of Charlie.
explanation.definitionFit: The cry of approval and the NATO code word for B are the same word.

clue.text: Mug draws up

indicators.note: in a down entry, up means the word is written bottom to top

parts.note: tows means pulls or draws along

explanation.surface: A mug being pulled upward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mug' looks like a cup or a dupe but is the British verb to mug up, to study hard.
explanation.definitionFit: To mug up is British slang for intensive study, the same as cramming hard.

clue.text: Teacher turned hint of triumph into defeat

indicators.note: the word for defeat is turned round
one letter is put into the other piece

parts.note: a rout is a crushing defeat

indicators.note: a hint is the first letter

explanation.surface: A teacher turned a sniff of victory into a loss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' puts the T of triumph inside ROUT to give ROTUT, which 'turned' then reverses.
explanation.definitionFit: A tutor is a private teacher or a university staff member who guides students.

clue.text: Albino mammal circling island for fish

parts.note: an albino is white

indicators.note: the mammal surrounds the island letter

parts.note: a bat is a flying mammal

explanation.surface: A pale creature flying round an island in search of fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Small young fish, such as sprats or herring, fried whole are known collectively by this name.

clue.text: Soldiers surrender, going over

parts.note: RE is the Royal Engineers, a British Army corps
capitulation is surrender

explanation.surface: Troops give up and defect to the other side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going over' suggests defecting but means summarising.
explanation.definitionFit: A recap is a summary that goes over the main points again.
